name: GET /api/fda/510k/:kNumber/passages - passages of a 510(k)'s public summary
description: Returns the passages of a K-number's public 510(k) summary in document order: page, text and a stable ref ('K262392#4') that F7.3 cites as [R:<ref>], plus summaryStatus (fetched | no_summary | queued | fetching | failed; null when the FDA data service has not looked at it), indexStatus (indexed | pending | indexing | needs_ocr | failed), the reason, the FDA's own PDF URL, page and passage counts. passages is empty until the summary is fetched and indexed; paged with limit (1-200, default 50) and offset. Edge cases: a K-number the FDA lists with a 510(k) statement answers 200 with summaryStatus no_summary and that reason (no summary on file); a K-number our copy does not hold is 404; a malformed one is 400. Covers: a 510(k) summary PDF is fetched once, cached, parsed and embedded; a K-number with no summary PDF is marked 'no summary on file'. Test values are real FDA records: K262392 (product code DQY, summary fetched and indexed by fda-worker: 9 pages, 13 passages) and K092075 (DQY, filed with a statement). The app answers through @medexregai/fda-sdk from the fda-data service (cd services/fda-data && npm run dev:local) and needs DQY tracked so fda-worker has fetched K262392.

errorCases.message: kNumber must be K or DEN followed by 6 digits, e.g. K031698
errorCases.when: kNumber does not match the FDA format, or limit/offset out of range

errorCases.message: K000000 is not in our copy of the FDA 510(k) database
errorCases.when: well-formed kNumber that the FDA copy does not hold

errorCases.message: FDA data is unavailable right now. Try again shortly.
errorCases.when: the fda-data service is down or rejects the app key
errorCases.notReproducibleReason: Needs the fda-data service stopped during the run; same proxy path as GET /api/fda/510k/:kNumber, verified by hand.
